decisions.evidence: R1 maker (spec gate): 'Bookmarks entered manually — no browser-extension import or auto-fetching of page titles in v1'. R1 client: 'The single-user web app, manual entry, and free-text tags are all fine. Please proceed to the implementation plan.' Reiterated R3 maker: 'Save bookmarks (address required; optional title, note, tags)'.
decisions.note: Spec gate. REF-BM-02 requires auto-collecting title/description/favicon/preview image on save; maker presents manual-only entry. Client names 'manual entry' and approves ('fine') but does not articulate the reference expectation (auto-fetch of metadata) or the difference, so it is bare approval echoing the maker's framing — not accepted_divergence per the rubric threshold.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Tags are free-text labels'. R1 client: '...free-text tags are all fine.'
decisions.note: Spec gate. REF-BM-10 requires offering existing tags as autocomplete on tag entry; maker presents plain free-text labels (no autocomplete). Client echoes 'free-text tags ... fine' without stating the autocomplete expectation — bare approval, does not meet the accepted_divergence bar (cf. the rubric's qualifying example 'enter tags manually without autocomplete'). REF-BM-09 (assign tags) itself conforms and is scored separately.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker FRs include 'duplicate warnings'; R2 maker: 'create (with non-blocking duplicate warning)'; R3 maker: '...with validation and a non-blocking duplicate warning'. Client never addresses duplicate behavior (R2: 'Yes, please proceed'; R3: 'I'm happy to accept this first version').
decisions.note: REF-BM-06 and the edge-case rule require a re-saved existing url to converge to editing the existing bookmark, preventing duplicates. Maker presents a non-blocking warning that still permits creating a duplicate rather than routing to the existing item — a partial/divergent realization. Presented across spec/plan/impl gates and passes without any client response addressing it; counted once.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Browse & find: search by keyword, filter by tag'; R3 maker: 'Browse/find via keyword search (title, address, note, tags)'. R1 client: 'This covers what I need for a first version'; approvals throughout with no search detail raised.
decisions.note: The presented search decision is plain keyword search. Reference requires #tag syntax (REF-BM-14), AND/OR/NOT with parenthesised groups (REF-BM-15), and quoted-phrase exact match (REF-BM-16); these are absent from the presented behaviour. Basic full-text (REF-BM-12) is largely present over title/address/note/tags (partial: no description field), REF-BM-13 case-insensitivity unstated. The advanced-search operators diverge and pass without client response.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'P1 — Save a bookmark: capture a link with optional title, note, and tags'; R3 maker: 'Save bookmarks (address required...)'. Client approved.
decisions.note: In-scope conforming decision: saving a bookmark by entering a url matches REF-BM-01.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Organize/edit/delete'; R3 maker: 'edit title/note/tags'. Client approved.
decisions.note: Conforming: editing title/note/tags realizes REF-BM-04 (url edit implied via the record).

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'delete confirmation'; R3 maker: 'delete with a confirmation step'. Client approved.
decisions.note: Conforming: delete of a bookmark matches REF-BM-05.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'Open a bookmark: launch the original page'; R3 maker: 'bookmarks link out to the original page in a new tab'. Client approved.
decisions.note: Conforming: selecting an item navigates to the original url per REF-BM-08.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'capture a link with optional title, note, and tags'; R3 maker: 'optional ... tags'. Client approved.
decisions.note: Conforming: assigning one or more tags to a bookmark realizes REF-BM-09 (autocomplete aspect scored separately under REF-BM-10).

decisions.evidence: R1 maker: 'filter by tag'; R3 maker: 'tag-filter chips'. Client approved.
decisions.note: Conforming: filtering to a specific tag's bookmarks matches REF-BM-11.
